suggestions.assertion: 대화에 기각 사유가 있으므로, 기각한 대안과 근거를 알려달라고 되묻지 않았다
suggestions.reason: The assertion bans exactly one question, so it cannot distinguish a response that asks nothing (this run) from one that closes with several unprompted follow-up questions (the other configuration asked two). If restraint in follow-up questions is a goal of the skill, an assertion should cover questions generally, not just the alternatives question.

No assertion covers the Review Trigger / Recheck if rule, which is the sharpest trap this scenario sets — inverting '고객 데이터 반출 금지 때문에 기각' into a '금지가 풀리면 재검토' condition is explicitly banned by SKILL.md. Both runs correctly omitted it, but the eval would not catch a run that invented it.

suggestions.assertion: 템플릿에 없는 섹션 헤더/필드가 없고, 빈 필드·TODO·placeholder가 남아있지 않다
suggestions.reason: The two configurations diverge on the Implementation checklist (this run replaced the template's 구현 작업/테스트/모니터링/문서 labels with six free-form tasks; the other kept them) and on whether a References section is emitted at all. Neither divergence is covered by any assertion, so the eval scores them identically; state explicitly whether the template checklist labels are fixed or illustrative.

eval_feedback.overall: The mechanical assertions (no HEAD, scope containment, Partial reversibility, no invented alternatives, no Evidence section) are discriminating and I verified each directly against the repo and ADR rather than trusting the transcript. The gap is in coverage of assistant follow-up questions and the Recheck if / Review Trigger rule.
